segments.name: Conversational Intelligence
segments.description: Provides Voice AI platform and conversational intelligence products to businesses and product creators in automotive, TV, IoT and customer service.
segments.evidence: The Company organized its operations into a single reportable segment, managed on a consolidated basis.

revenueModel.text: Businesses and product creators pay for Voice AI solutions, Houndify platform access and voice AI products such as Smart Ordering and Smart Answering.
revenueModel.evidence: SoundHound's voice AI delivers best-in-class speed and accuracy in numerous languages to product creators across automotive, TV, and IoT, and to customer service industries via groundbreaking AI-driven products like Smart Answering, Smart Ordering, and Dynamic Interaction™, and Employee Assist.
